_comment: Edit this file, then run.bat. Run 'npm run processes' and 'npm run devices' to find the values below.

incoming._playbackDeviceNote: Empty = Windows default (your headphones). This is where you HEAR the translation.

outgoing._micDeviceNote: Exact dshow name from 'npm run devices', e.g. 'Microphone (HyperX QuadCast)'
outgoing._playbackDeviceNote: This is the virtual mic the game reads. Set the game's mic input to 'CABLE Output'.

translate._backendNote: 'whisper' = free X->English only. 'llama' = local llama-server, any language pair, handles slang.
